title: Record undocumented receipt request
description: Payload for `POST /receipts`. A consignmentNote is required when any waste item declares hazardous properties; the service checks that, as the rule spans the waste items and the consignment note.

reasonForNoDeliveryId.description: Why this Receipt has no Delivery ID. Required, because this route is for Receipts without one; a Receipt with a Delivery ID is recorded at `POST /deliveries/{deliveryId}/receipt`.
examples: No delivery was recorded prior to receipt; waste received directly from the producer.

receiptDateTime.description: When the waste was received at the receiver's site.

carrier.description: The carrier that delivered the waste.

receiver.description: The receiver that received the waste.

wasteItems.description: The items of waste received. At least one is required, and every item needs at least one treatment.

treatments.description: Required on every waste item of a Receipt: at least one disposal or recovery operation

brokerOrDealer.description: Any broker or dealer involved in the Movement.

supportingReferences.description: References that help identify the Receipt, such as a PO or job number.

consignmentNote.description: The hazardous waste consignment note. Required when any waste item declares hazardous properties.
